guidance.claim: Full year revenue growth guidance is revised to 1% to 2% YoY.
guidance.quote: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for the rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY in constant currency terms.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

guidance.claim: Operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.
guidance.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

guidance.claim: Target remains approximately 20,000 freshers for the full year.
guidance.quote: For the full year, our target remains clear at approximately 20,000, so around 20,000 like last year.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

guidance.claim: Effective tax rate for the year is expected to be 29% to 30%.
guidance.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
guidance.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Q2 revenue growth was 1.5% YoY and 1.2% sequentially in constant currency.
reported.quote: Our revenue growth for Q2 was 1.5% YoY and 1.2% sequentially in constant currency terms.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: AI revenue reached 10.5% of total revenue, growing 29% sequentially.
reported.quote: AI revenue was a standout at 10.5% of our revenue, growing at 29% sequentially.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Operating margin was stable at 21% for the quarter.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Won 19 large deals in Q2 with a TCV of $5.2 billion.
reported.quote: We won 19 large deals in Q2 with a TCV of $5.2 bn, which is second highest quarterly TCV in the last five years.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary

reported.claim: Free cash flow was $928 million, representing 113% of net profit.
reported.quote: Free cash flow generation was strong at $928 mn at 113% of net profit.
reported.speaker: Company Secretary
